purpose: Deliver the README task with independent design and test evidence, then verified implementation.

coordinator.name: implementing-lead
coordinator.purpose: Own all implementation edits, consult the verification group, run tests, collect every collaborator result and reconcile relevant findings before final response.

swarms.purpose: Find specification edge cases and concrete verification guidance without changing implementation files.

coordinator.name: verification-coordinator
coordinator.purpose: Read README, combine scoped evidence from both group peers using bounded mailbox waits, challenge material disagreements, then send a concise actionable synthesis upward to the root lead. Do not edit files.

agents.name: specification-reviewer
agents.purpose: Read README and current implementation. Identify the three highest-risk correctness requirements and examples. Send concise evidence directly to your group coordinator, optionally discuss disagreements with the testing peer, then finish. Do not edit files.

agents.name: testing-reviewer
agents.purpose: Read README and current implementation. Derive focused edge-case and failure tests. Send concise concrete cases directly to your group coordinator, optionally discuss disagreements with the specification peer, then finish. Do not edit files.
